proposals.title: Extract pricing rules
proposals.rationale: Make pricing testable without HTTP or storage.
steps: Capture current price calculation behavior with boundary cases.
Extract a pure CalculatePrice function into orders/pricing.go.
Call it from the HTTP handler while preserving response semantics.

proposals.title: Reuse pricing in imports
proposals.rationale: Use one set of rules for both entry points.
steps: Compare existing import and HTTP rounding behavior.
Replace duplicate import pricing with CalculatePrice.
verification: Run import regression tests and compare totals against existing fixtures.
risks: Imported orders may intentionally use a different pricing policy; confirm before implementation.
